new.description: overlapping templates, wholly-excluded overlap, built-ins pass

edit.description: governs_collision_diagnostics judges template overlap less excludes, not root+glob string equality
a template-overlap predicate beside locus_admits, honoring excluded paths and directories

summary: The governs-collision check compares the paths two kinds govern, not their glob strings
acceptance: two kinds whose templates (less their excludes) can match one path draw kind.governs-collision; the built-in set draws none
tests: two kinds whose distinct templates share a governed path draw a governs collision
two kinds whose shared paths are wholly excluded draw no governs collision
pins: the built in kinds draw no governs collision
notes: Per 0081/0084. The template grammar (literal segments, one `*`, optional leading `**/`) keeps overlap decidable without enumerating a tree. Manifest and nested-file kinds stay out as today. May surface new findings on the dogfood .temper corpus — a record, not a src change.
